decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment sits far from the firm's maritime knowledge base, which limits its ability to interpret results and improve the service, but it reuses the firm's existing crewing and recruitment infrastructure at low cost, so it is likely kept for now despite elevated risk.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's core crewing know-how and seafarer network, so the firm can absorb market feedback and refine the service easily.

The Smart Academy draws on the firm's training centres and has quickly grown to six partner institutions, a research cooperation network that strengthens absorptive capacity and signals strong commitment.

FuelEU monitoring and compliance is regulation-driven, close to the core technical management offer, and already delivered all monitoring plans on time, giving clear evidence the firm has mastered it.
The dashboard is integrated into the firm's own PAL software and supports the compliance service, so in-house development capability and the regulatory demand make it worth keeping.
The cost simulation tool complements the dashboard within the PAL platform and matches the firm's digitalisation and environmental strategy, which it can develop further with its own R&D.
